businesses.business: pool and outdoor living supply distribution and franchising

offering_description.value: Pool Corporation distributes swimming pool and spa supplies to pool builders, service companies and specialty retailers. It also supplies irrigation and landscape contractors through its wholesale branch network. In the United States, it franchises specialty pool supply stores.

primary_products.value: pool and spa equipment and replacement parts; pool and spa chemicals; pool construction and renovation materials; irrigation and landscape supplies; outdoor living products

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pool builders, pool service companies, specialty retailers, pool store franchisees, and irrigation and landscape contractors

end_markets.value: pool construction and renovation; pool and spa maintenance; specialty pool retail; landscape irrigation; outdoor living

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wholesale purchases of pool, spa, irrigation and outdoor living supplies; licensing or royalties: Franchise fees and royalties from specialty pool store operators

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Buys supplies from manufacturers and sells them to pool and landscape trades, retailers and franchisees; brand owner: Sources private-label pool and spa supplies for sale to trade customers and retailers; service provider: Licenses its store brand and operating system to independent pool supply retailers

geography_served.value: global: Wholesale operations in North America, Europe and Australia, with retail franchising in the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Pool and spa supplies, irrigation and landscape supplies, outdoor living products, and pool supply retail franchising

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated wholesale sales centers serving local trade accounts; online: Online ordering portals for trade customers; partners / resellers: Independent specialty pool retailers and franchised pool supply stores

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Pool sanitizers are subject to EPA pesticide rules, and hazardous chemical shipments follow transportation safety rules.
